The article discusses a space mission led by veteran NASA astronaut Colonel William Mc. Arthur Jr., who is the Chief Astronaut of the Titans Space Mission. The text mentions that over the next three years, starting from 2026, the astronaut will undergo intensive training through Titan Space's ASCAN programme. This training includes flight simulation, spacecraft procedures, survival training, medical and psychological evaluations, as stated by Ms.
